note: golive-g7: docs/124 §17 G7 dry apply, NOT RUN. [AutShadow] Mode=3 Dry=1: every eligible meta search posts, waits for the worker (Satb=2: the job runs on through the next tick; Satb off: in the window, WindowWaitUs 5000) and computes what consume would send (band 1 = the worker's top 10 passing pairs, off-list ads, live objects, the §16.1 bands), then runs the game's own B13 unchanged and compares the queue it builds with the one consume would have built (top-10 set, top 1). Nothing is used. ts3native 0.36.142 (asi golive1) + ts3fixes package golive1 (build-fixes.ts --on kAutLive: the B14 hook is patched only in that package). Correctness queue, daytime allowed. Read: node tools/harness/mono-cost-report.ts <queue jsonl> ("go-live" lines; G7 line with Dry=1) and the Satb act line; records: autshadow.jsonl dry-diff / live-drop next to ts3native.ini.

smoke.note: Smoke (4 min BP, Satb=2, Dry=1): PASS = 0 crashes; ts3native.log "autshadow go-live: Mode=3 ... Dry=1"; -native.json alOn 3, al eligible > 0, al posted > 0, al dry > 0, drySimMis 0; ts3fixes applied log has "AutShadow: go-live Mode 3 (dry)" and no "go-live off". A FAIL stops the queue.

jobs.note: G7 BP, Satb=2 (the go-live configuration), 10 min natural play. PASS (docs/124 §8 G7, §16.3): 0 crashes; -native.json autshadow alOn 3 (Mode 3 + Dry), al dry >= 2,000 searches per world over the queue; top-10 set equal >= 99% and top 1 equal >= 99.5% (report "G7 dry apply"); game queue replay mismatches (drySimMis) 0; every miss has a cause (dryMissStale = a worker-failed pair now passes, dryMissBand = ranked below the bands; dryMissOther must be ~0: read the dry-diff records); verify cuts: A1-A3 0, live off by verify 0; fallbacks sized by reason (wait, stopped, epoch, lot, actor fields). Fail: widen TopN/Margin once or add the missing invalidation (docs/124 §14.4 S3 stop rule).
